S.FORM: === u siwkay niza === Tao Ching Ying (1969.10.29) tatayna, nalecuhan i Taywan Taypak. u malimula' a ngangan sa ci Taoce. pahezekan i Taypak Cungsan Tatayna Teban a cacudadan. pahezekan i Kanatal Cengce Tabakiay a cacudadan, Sinbung a Si. u singanganay a tilibi palaw-ngatu telungay. matieng mudadiw, matineng misulit ku cudad, matineng misanga' ku palaw-ngatu. 1990 a mihcan, sakacacay a dadiw-balud mutahkal. ayzasa, u sakapahay a telungay ciniza. mitelung ku laziw a palaw-ngatu ciniza, kayadah a lawad. i Taywan a palaw-saliyut sa, u takalaway mitesekay a misakakawaway. u sapuyaay a kakuniza u kawaw niza u sulit nu Hulam Matilda Tao Ching-ying (Chinese: 陶晶莹; pinyin: Táo Jīngyíng) is a Taiwanese singer, television host and author. Tao graduated from National Chengchi University. In 2005, she married Taiwanese actor Lee Lee-zen. maala kawlah a nazipa'an u insac niza namakayniay a nasulitan nasakamuan atu natinengan 陶晶瑩-
S.PHON: === u siwkaj niza === tao ʦħiŋ jiŋ (****.**.**) tatajna, nar~ɾəʦuħan i tajwan tajpak. u mar~ɾimur~ɾaʔ~ʡ a ŋaŋan sa ʦi taoʦə. paħəzəkan i tajpak ʦuŋsan tatajna təban a ʦaʦudadan. paħəzəkan i kanatar~ɾ ʦəŋʦə tabakiaj a ʦaʦudadan, sinbuŋ a si. u siŋaŋanaj a tir~ɾibi par~ɾaw-ŋatu tər~ɾuŋaj. matiəŋ mudadiw, matinəŋ misur~ɾit ku ʦudad, matinəŋ misaŋaʔ~ʡ ku par~ɾaw-ŋatu. **** a miħʦan, sakaʦaʦaj a dadiw-bar~ɾud mutaħkar~ɾ. ajzasa, u sakapaħaj a tər~ɾuŋaj ʦiniza. mitər~ɾuŋ ku r~ɾaziw a par~ɾaw-ŋatu ʦiniza, kajadaħ a r~ɾawad. i tajwan a par~ɾaw-sar~ɾijut sa, u takar~ɾawaj mitəsəkaj a misakakawawaj. u sapujaaj a kakuniza u kawaw niza u sur~ɾit nu ħur~ɾam matir~ɾda tao ʦħiŋ-jiŋ (ʦħinəsə: ***; pinjin: t*o **ŋj*ŋ) is a taiwanəsə siŋər, tər~ɾə*ision ħost and autħor. tao graduatəd from nationar~ɾ ʦħəŋʦħi uni*ərsitj. in ****, sħə marriəd taiwanəsə aʦtor r~ɾəə r~ɾəə-zən. maar~ɾa kawr~ɾaħ a nazipaʔ~ʡan u insaʦ niza namakajniaj a nasur~ɾitan nasakamuan atu natinəŋan ***-
